cards.title: Hour 14 error spike
cards.detail: Hour 14 recorded 1,460 errors from 9,225 requests (15.8% error rate), compared to an average of 31 errors per hour in other hours (0.35%). This spike requires investigation.

cards.title: Model epsilon 100% failure
cards.detail: Model epsilon had 40 requests and 40 errors, a 100% error rate. This model may be misconfigured or unavailable.

cards.title: Caller-07 high cost per request
cards.detail: Caller-07 spent $174.12 on 1,180 requests, an average of $0.148 per request, which is 9x the overall average of $0.016. Review its model selection or usage.

cards.title: Low cache hit rates for several callers
cards.detail: Nine callers have cache hit rates below 10% (e.g., caller-03 at 7.7%, caller-07 at 4.0%, caller-21 at 3.7%). Optimizing caching could reduce costs and latency.

cards.title: Caller-01 dominates traffic
cards.detail: Caller-01 accounts for 105,832 requests (51.6% of total) and $1,643.86 spend (49.0%). Its performance is critical to overall system health.

cards.title: Caller-22 outlier single request cost
cards.detail: Caller-22 made a single request costing $3.10, over 180 times the average cost per request. This may indicate a billing or configuration error.
